rows.text: Legal CLASS occupant of the color-pipe with extra c2, not unique color?
rows.why: unique_color type is FORBIDDEN. An SU(3) bundle on S^2×S^2 with c2 listed is a pipe member, not a derived color group.

rows.text: Does Euler (1,1) force c2 of that SU(3) bundle?
rows.why: Euler (1, 1) is in H^2. Its cup square is 2, the self-pairing of that U(1) class. c2 of an SU(3) bundle is a class in H^4 and is not that pairing. Integers obtained for c2: none.

rows.text: Does HARM_2 or b2=1 force c2?
rows.why: b2=1 is the rank of H^2 of T^{1,1}. HARM_2 is the harmonic 2-form in that line. Neither assigns an element of H^4. Integers obtained for c2: none.

rows.text: Does Iso contain SU(3) so the bundle is derived?
rows.why: dim Iso=7, dim SU(3)=8. 7<8, so Iso does not contain SU(3).

rows.text: Unique color stays FORBIDDEN; pipe stays CLASS; c2 stays EXTERNAL.
rows.why: C2, C3, and C4 are No. unique_color stays FORBIDDEN. The pipe stays CLASS.
